items.title: Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.

Last season, those 4 players combined to shoot 36.1% over nearly 1,300 attempts.

Seems safe to project more shots will be falling in the future.

Asa Newell is checking in.

items.title: Jock Landale just picked up the first technical foul of the season for the Hawks.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Jock Landale just picked up the first technical foul of the season for the Hawks.

Ended up being a double technical with Jabari Smith Jr. as they exchanged plesantries.

He got decked in the game against Orlando on Wednesday, but ended up staying in.
